body_html:
There are two ways to join Dr. McVerry in watching the State of the Union Address.

You can use the public forum on hypothes.is to annotate, which means to take notes with students from around the country. Other people will see your work. 

It is important to engage in civics and politics. To sign up for an account go here.

People will also be sharing and talking about the State of the Union on Twitter. If you just want to watch and not participate publicly go to the Twitter feed here: 

Members of Gear Up New Haven can also join our live chatroom using Remind. Anyone with a cellphone who can text can join us to discuss the State of the Union Address live.

Directions on joining the chat room will be texted. Come say goodbye and celebrate the 44th President, Barak Obama.
